text_block_list.text:
I'm gathering some data with Biwa<n>Hayahide in
preparation for our next<n>race when a muscle in my
arm<n>twinges painfully.
Crick.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Trainer?!

Biwa Hayahide looks worried as she<n>watches me
hold my injured arm.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
How much pain are you in? Where<n>does it hurt? Is
there any swelling?

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
No, you're not! What if it's something<n>serious? We
need to get that looked<n>at right away!
She drags me to the infirmary...

text_block_list.name: Infirmary Doctor
text_block_list.text: It's tendinitis.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: What?

text_block_list.name: Infirmary Doctor
text_block_list.text:
You're going to have to give your arm<n>and hand
some rest. If it worsens,<n>you might even require
surgery.
choice_data_list: I feel so bad about this...

text_block_list.name: Infirmary Doctor
text_block_list.text:
Icing the area won't be enough.<n>You'll have to stop
using your arm for<n>a bit. The good news is there's
no<n>swelling, so it's not too serious.

text_block_list.name: Infirmary Doctor
Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Sigh...

text_block_list.name: Infirmary Doctor
text_block_list.text:
Hehe, bit of a worrywart? I get the<n>feeling you
already knew the injury<n>wasn't that bad from the
start.

text_block_list.name: Infirmary Doctor
text_block_list.text:
But the fact that you insisted on<n>coming here
proves just how much<n>you care about your trainer.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: I-I, uh...

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
If you're feeling better in two or three<n>days, let's
go to a hot spring.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Because the least I can do is take<n>care of you, and
you need plenty of<n>rest. You'd better not worry
about my<n>training for at least a week.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
You should apply for some time off<n>and take a
break. If something needs<n>to be handled right away,
we can ask<n>Tazuna to help.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
I want you to contact me right away if<n>your
symptoms worsen or if you<n>develop a fever. And
on the day we<n>go to the hot spring—

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Excuse me? Do you really think<n>you're in any
position to object?
That look in her eyes... She's not<n>messing around!
The day of our hot spring getaway<n>arrives.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
According to my research, the water<n>here is highly
recommended for<n>soothing medical ailments. It
should<n>be well-suited to heal your injury.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Don't worry. This just so happens to<n>be the same
place I won a free trip to<n>a while back. Therefore,
we can<n>enjoy this vacation free of charge.

Come to think of it, I do remember her<n>getting a
voucher for a hot spring<n>vacation some time ago...

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Let's not waste any time and go in.
Soaking in the hot spring...

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Phew... That was great. Did you<n>enjoy your bath
too?
choice_data_list: Absolutely. All my muscle tension's gone.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Good. That soak must've improved<n>your blood
circulation.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Hm? Oh, I should've asked if there<n>were any foods
you don't like. I did<n>make sure to avoid the allergies
you<n>told me about, but...
choice_data_list:
No, it's not that. I just want you to slow down a
little.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: ...Slow down?
choice_data_list: I want you to enjoy yourself, since we're here.
I want you to enjoy yourself, since we're here.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
You're constantly worrying about me<n>and putting
my needs ahead of yours.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: So why don't you just let me worryabout you for once?
choice_data_list:
I know you're concerned, but you need to take it
easy too.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Hmph...
choice_data_list:
Come on, let's get some drinks to hydrate
ourselves.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: ...Okay. Good idea.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Ahh...
choice_data_list: Do you feel a little more relaxed now?

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
I've been feeling relaxed from the<n>beginning, since
you're by my side.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Let's have them bring us our dinner<n>now. It'll be
nice to sit back and<n>enjoy a meal.

After our meal is brought to us, we<n>enjoy a
delicious and nutritious<n>dinner together.

I sense that Biwa Hayahide and I<n>have formed an
irreplaceable bond<n>during this time together.
